method: Read-only exact NMLS lookups against production GET /api/specialist-execution/v2?q=NMLS {id} (queryType identifier, matchMethod exact_key). No writes.

mlo_sample.sample: 250 individual NMLS IDs chosen by sha256('ma-lend-001:'+id) order (deterministic)
mlo_sample.note: Sample only; not a full person reconciliation. Person IDs are not committed.

local_catalog.note: lib/mockData catalog is a legacy directory, not the identity graph; Massachusetts rows there are illustrative and not used as evidence.

interpretation: DOB rows are credential evidence on existing NMLS identities where they exist. No canonical organizations or public profiles are created from DOB rows; unmatched NMLS IDs stay research identities in this snapshot.
